title: Datasource driver forms: field labels and descriptions (Filename, Auto-migrate schema, Host, Port) are English in every console language
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVwQZbHRRM9CaXeKif

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing, read in the tree and measured live. Filed by the `domain:ui#5` seat from the out-of-scope finding of #30327's card thread, os-dev-report 6662619947 (#30327 asked for these labels in the console's language). Carrier: the server lane.

**Business reason.** An administrator in a Chinese console creating a datasource reads every driver field (Filename, Auto-migrate schema, Host, Port) and their help in English, beside Chinese text everywhere else in the dialog.

**Reader.** The server lane dev: the labels are the JSON-Schema `title` / `description` of `packages/spec/src/data/driver/*.zod.ts`, served by `GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers` (`packages/services/service-datasource`, `driver-catalog.ts`).

## Measured

- Live, zh console: the SQLite driver entry's fields read `Filename` and `Auto-migrate schema`, and the driver description is English.
- The console draws what the drivers endpoint serves; it has no key of its own for these fields.

## Expected

- The drivers endpoint serves each field's label and description in the requester's language (or translation keys the console can resolve), so the dialog reads in one language.
